description:
The container-tools module contains tools for working with containers, notably podman, buildah, skopeo, and runc.  

Security Fix(es):  

  * net/[http:](http:) golang: golang: Denial of Service via crafted HTTP Range headers (CVE-2026-78667)
  * crypto/x509: golang: crypto/x509: Man-in-the-middle attacks via untrusted intermediate certificates (CVE-2026-111943)


Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):  

  * container-tools:rhel8: buildah RPM has the wrong version (JIRA:AlmaLinux-272014)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
solution:
For details on how to apply this update, which includes the changes described in this advisory, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
